title: Design: Move To COD shows the $0 line under the hint
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop is moving Net 7 customers to COD, and you compare the $0 line with the design.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • At least two customers are on Net 7.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p2-06-move-to-cod-the-0-line.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the Net 7 row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Look under Move To.
  4. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the row menu opens.
  • Step 2: the "Move Customers from Net 7" window opens with "Move To" reading COD.
  • Step 3: two grey lines show under it: "Prefilled with your default for new customers." and "Their credit limit will be set to $0." (as in ct-p2-06-move-to-cod-the-0-line.png).
  • Step 4: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R7: “"Move To" offers every active term except the one being moved from, in the S1-R5 order. It is prefilled with the shop's default; while the default is selected, the hint "Prefilled with your default for new customers." shows below it. When the term being moved from is the default, "Move To" starts empty.”
  • S4-R10: “When "Move To" is COD or Credit Hold, the window shows the line "Their credit limit will be set to $0." below "Move To".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Move To is COD or Credit Hold | "Their credit limit will be set to $0." | Line under Move To while COD or Credit Hold is selected”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Move To hint | "Prefilled with your default for new customers." | Hint under Move To while the default is selected”
